summary: Bug: First page of downloaded invoice appears blank — invoice content starts from page 2
reported_issue: When downloading an invoice that includes a long technician story, the first page of the PDF is blank and the actual invoice content begins on page 2. Occurs consistently with lengthy tech-story text.
expected_after_fix: The invoice PDF renders its content starting on page 1 (no blank leading page) even when a long technician story is present.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin. Located the invoice PDF generation path: button_download_invoice and endpoint /api/invoices/preview?invoice_id=<id>&type=pdf.
Fetched and analyzed the PDF byte streams (zlib-inflate of content streams + text-operator counting) for 10 real invoices on staging.
Attempted to construct the exact repro: add a long (~2500 char) technician story to a line and generate its PDF.
Attempted estimate-preview PDF generation via WO id to bypass invoice creation.
actual_now: General PDF pipeline check: all 10 invoices analyzed render their content on the FIRST page (first content stream carries the primary text, ~13 BT / ~80 Tj operators); none exhibited a blank leading page. However, the exact reported trigger (a long technician story spanning multiple pages) could NOT be constructed in this harness: (1) the rich-text tech-story editor did not persist programmatic input, (2) creating a new invoice requires the review->invoice flow which is gated (the 'Reviewed' button was disabled on available test WOs), and (3) the estimate-preview PDF endpoint rejects a WO id and requires an existing invoice_id. No existing invoice on staging had a long/multi-page tech story to test against.
notes: Partial positive evidence: the invoice PDF renderer places content on page 1 for all 10 real invoices tested (no blank first page). But the specific long-tech-story multi-page condition that triggers the reported bug could not be created in the automated harness (tech-story editor + gated invoice generation), so a definitive FIXED/STILL-REPRODUCES verdict for the exact scenario is not possible here.
